description: Installable Svelte 5 chart components with parallel LayerChart and Apache ECharts providers, delivered through a shadcn-svelte registry.
rules: Use the Svelte 5 examples and the provider-specific LayerChart or Apache ECharts component APIs from this repository.
Keep provider names explicit: LayerChart components use the Evil*Chart prefix and Apache ECharts components use the ECharts*Chart prefix.
Install components from the Evil Charts SV shadcn-svelte registry before importing them.
Do not substitute the original React EvilCharts API for this Svelte port.
